system.description:
Make an Interface Roll against a target
within Close range.
On a success, roll a number of d20s
equal to your Interface trait. The target
must make a Reaction Roll with a
Difficulty equal to your highest result.
On a success, the target must mark a
Stress but isn’t banished.
Once per rest on a failure, they are
banished from this battlefield, signal
layer, or active physical space.
When the PCs roll with Fear, the
Difficulty gains a -1 penalty and the
target makes another Reaction Roll. On
a success, they return from
banishment.
